findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素指出：公司所處商業與政府市場技術快速變動，需持續投資研發、併購或合作才能維持競爭力；並提到商用核電（含 SMR）發展延遲可能影響業績。
findings.excerpt: The commercial and government markets in which we operate are characterized by rapidly changing technologies. In addition, product and program needs of our government and commercial customers change and evolve regularly.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：商用核電產業的任何重大中斷（含 SMR 開發延遲）可能影響營運結果或展望。
findings.excerpt: Any significant disruption in the commercial nuclear power industry, including delays in the development of small modular reactors, could adversely affect our results of operations or future outlook.

findings.claim: 搜尋摘要顯示 CW 為多家 SMR 的指定供應商（Rolls-Royce SMR 反應爐保護系統、X-energy Xe-100 氦氣循環器與燃料處理、NuScale 控制棒驅動），搜尋未發現取代其產品的替代技術。
findings.source: WebSearch 摘要（power-eng.com／X-energy／Rolls-Royce SMR 公告）

note: 僅執行1次搜尋；2026 年無找到具體替代技術威脅來源。
